script: Bro, why does Dwyane Wade treat his son differently? Meanwhile, other NBA dads treat their kids with love, then LeBron goes crazy after Bronny throws down a dunk. But Dwayne Wade was a little crazy. You wanna beat me, you gotta beat me. Cooked his own son.
retention_tricks: rapid cuts between different NBA fathers and sons
contrasting sweet moments with aggressive competitive moments
what_makes_it_work: The funny contrast between loving NBA dads and Dwyane Wade playing hyper-competitively against his son.
High pacing with quick cuts keeping viewers engaged throughout.
Strong emotional reactions from players like LeBron James adding entertainment value.
